title: Kagamine Len — Swimming In Cider〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Looks like we're all here!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Why'd you ask us to gather all of a sudden, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Before I explain, take a look at these.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Snacks and drinks...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, these are from the party we threw to celebrate Ichi and the girls' song becoming a huge hit!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There's still this much left?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Come to think of it, we became so enamored with Ichika's story that we basically stopped eating and drinking...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Exactly. They went out of their way to bring these over, so I'd rather not let them go to waste.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Just look at how much cider we have left over.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, FizzYum Cider!
I didn't know we still had some.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The grape-flavored one that I had first was really good, so I've been wanting to try some of the other flavors.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Me too.
But is it really okay for us to have these all to ourselves...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. I asked Saki, and she said we could have them since they probably won't be able to visit for a little while.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If that's the case, then let's start digging in.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, I'd like some of those chocolate chip cookies.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I'd like some as well...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm gonna have some of these fruit gummies and the classic FizzYum Cider♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Would you mind pouring me some as well, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay♪ I'll get some cups for us!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: As for me...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... These butter cookies look good, but so do these chocolate bars...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We have plenty, so why not have both?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: True. In that case...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Humhumhumm♪ Plop, plop, plop!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wait, Rin...!
Why are you putting gummies in your cider?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Heh heh. Sakki taught me this♪
You can get this cider to taste like fruit punch by putting in different flavored gummies.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: R-Really?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Those gummy bears look like they're drowning in her cider...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The bubbles make it seem all too real.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, how do you drink...no, eat that?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's easy. Just drink the cider and chew on the gummies at the same time♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, bottoms up!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Mmm! I love how well this fizziness mixes with the chewiness of these gummies♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really? I still feel like it's better to have them separately...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, if you're gonna say that, then try it yourself! Here, gimme your cup♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, wait!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Pour in the cider, plop in a few gummies and...♪ Okay, it's ready!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That looks like fun.
Would you mind pouring me a cup, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I'd like one as well.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What do I do with this gummy cider...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Drink it?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: KAITO and I will split the rest if you don't like it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
That's a promise.
Alright...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, this is better than I thought...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: See?! It's good, right?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, I didn't say that it's good.
It's just... More palatable than I expected...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: In other words, you think it's good♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We've still got plenty of cider and gummies, so I'll get you as many refills as you like!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In that case, I think I'll take a cup.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, me too...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! Coming right up♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I still don't believe it...
I was so sure that these would be better separate.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha! What if this is just like how a band works?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Because you have very different instruments playing all at once? A guitar, a bass, drums and a keyboard...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Exactly. There's music which only that mix of instruments can produce.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
That's cool and all.
But can you really put this gummy cider on the same level...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think that depends on who you ask.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I'll take another sip...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, this is surprisingly okay...
